analogy.rationale: BMP inhibitors block ACVR1/BMPR1A, serine/threonine kinases in the TGF-beta superfamily, so TGF beta receptor inhibitors share the closest downstream SMAD signaling program; other kinase inhibitors overlap only weakly, and these epithelial lines express low BMP receptor levels, giving a weak overall response.
